hint: tap anywhere to pluck the veena

game.q: besides the veena, narada is known for what?
opts: stirring up quarrels that end well

wrong.dj: the veena does slap. but no.

game.right: YES. he carries news, and gossip, between gods and kings, and the trouble turns out for the good.

end.line: a sage said two words everywhere he went, until they became who he was.
end.l2: until they became who he was.

cliff.s1: next: shiva says food doesn’t matter.

share: he’s in heaven. he’s on earth. he’s everywhere. the narada story on infinite hill
